senses.gloss: (b. h. צלע; cmp. טלל) [to hang over, incline,] to halt.

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 32:32">Targ. Gen. XXXII, 32</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00485"><he>טְלַח</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Yevamot 39b:10">Yeb. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>אַטְלַע לה רגליך וכ׳</he> turn thy right foot towards her <he>ואטלע לה וכ׳</he> and he did so, Rashi; v. next w.]
